notes.title: Game Update
notes.notes:
Glad to welcome everyone! The game has received an update, list of changes/additions below:

[list]
[*] Added new vegetation on the train tracks
[*] Improved textures of all stations
[*] Fixed a bug where a character could sit on a chair and then get up and end up on the street.
[*] Fixed bugs in translations (English and Chinese)
[*] Optimized train layout
[/list]

We also offer you to read about the new game under development [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2757610/TransSiberian_Express/]Trans-Siberian Express[/url].

Have a good trip!

notes.title: DLC release and game update!
notes.notes:
So, yesterday was the release of four DLC, which will bring to the game a lot of interesting content and features.

So, let's go in order:

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2402040/Russian_Train_Trip_2__fast_time/]Russian Train Trip 2 - fast time[/url] - Adds time acceleration to the game to see all the content, all the train stations and not spend 10 hours playing the game. Only works after the "Pillars" station!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2402150/Russian_Train_Trip_2__VIP_seat_in_the_train_car/]Russian Train Trip 2 - VIP seat in the train car[/url] - Makes your compartment car into a real VIP seat with many different items.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2402151/Russian_Train_Trip_2__A_beautiful_girl_in_your_place/]Russian Train Trip 2 - A beautiful girl in your place[/url] - Adds a female companion to your compartment car. The girl lies on top of your seat and is a joy to look at.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2402152/Russian_Train_Trip_2__Putins_posters_in_the_train_car/]Russian Train Trip 2 - Putin's posters in the train car[/url] - This DLC adds Vladimir Putin posters to your coach compartment. The posters hang on two walls and are always a joy to behold, no matter where you sit.

Also updated the client, where in addition to adding content, have been fixed bugs such as non-functioning radio and other things.

notes.title: The game is out for release!
notes.notes:
Today the game has been released as version 1.0! Hurry to update the game.

You are waiting for a long journey to Vladivostok on the Trans-Siberian Railway.

Dear players, please take into account a few points before you buy the game:
[olist]
[*] In the game the time is real, without acceleration, which means you will have to go quite a long way from station to station. Be prepared for that.
[*] It's a simulator of travelling and riding in passenger cars: which means there will be nothing but travelling, moving around the carriage, walking through railway stations, being able to look out the windows, sit, lie down in seats, admire the views.
[/olist]

notes.title: The release trailer is out
notes.notes:
So, the game is almost ready, and meanwhile the trailer of the final version of the game was released.

As you can notice, the game has changed the weather, now it will be summer instead of winter.

[previewyoutube=493zi1_zkT4;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Update: bug fixes
notes.notes:
Finally the bug with the rotating camera was fixed, I had to rewrite almost 1/3 of the game code.

At the moment in the game added electric train, on which the story you will need to get to the first train station, to change to the main train to Vladivostok.

notes.title: Update from March 15
notes.notes:
This update adds passengers: a young girl and a man. Both are animated.
It seems to be a trifle, but it adds quite a tangible atmosphere to the car.



As for the bugs: the work is being done, we are aware of them.

notes.title: Update from March 13
notes.notes:
Thank you to everyone who supports this game, the work goes on daily, there are many small fixes, but list the main in this update of March 13:

[list]
[*] General optimization has been done, and as the tests show, the performance gain was about 20-30% without loss of quality. Please check if you have had problems with FPS before.
[*] Added music to menu
[*] Added big sound of tires beating
[*] Added sound of locomotive whistle, pulling cars
[*] Added upper berth (you can lie down there)
[/list]
